# {{ site.title }}

{{ site.description | strip }}

Canonical: {{ site.url }}

{% comment %} Bilingual link map (#98): one section per language so crawlers
  and LLMs can pick a side. English pages/posts under `## English`, their
  Vietnamese translations under `## Tiếng Việt`, linked by the shared `ref`.
  Redirect stubs, feeds, sitemap/llms/robots themselves are never listed.
{% endcomment %}
## English
{%- for page in site.pages %}
{%- if page.layout == "page" and page.permalink %}
{%- assign llms_lang = page.lang | default: site.lang | default: 'en' %}
{%- if llms_lang == 'en' %}
{%- unless page.url contains "404" or page.url contains "feed.xml" or page.url contains "sitemap.xml" or page.url contains "llms.txt" or page.url contains "robots.txt" %}
- {{ site.url }}{{ page.permalink }}: {% if page.description %}{{ page.description | strip_newlines | strip }}{% elsif page.excerpt %}{{ page.excerpt | strip_html | strip_newlines | truncate: 155, "..." | strip }}{% else %}{{ page.title }}{% endif %}
{%- endunless %}
{%- endif %}
{%- endif %}
{%- endfor %}
{%- for post in site.posts %}
{%- if post.url %}
- {{ site.url }}{{ post.url }}: {% if post.description %}{{ post.description | strip_newlines | strip }}{% elsif post.excerpt %}{{ post.excerpt | strip_html | strip_newlines | truncate: 155, "..." | strip }}{% else %}{{ post.title }}{% endif %}
{%- endif %}
{%- endfor %}

## Tiếng Việt
{%- for page in site.pages %}
{%- if page.layout == "page" and page.permalink %}
{%- assign llms_lang = page.lang | default: site.lang | default: 'en' %}
{%- if llms_lang == 'vi' %}
{%- unless page.url contains "404" or page.url contains "feed.xml" or page.url contains "sitemap.xml" or page.url contains "llms.txt" or page.url contains "robots.txt" %}
- {{ site.url }}{{ page.permalink }}: {% if page.description %}{{ page.description | strip_newlines | strip }}{% elsif page.excerpt %}{{ page.excerpt | strip_html | strip_newlines | truncate: 155, "..." | strip }}{% else %}{{ page.title }}{% endif %}
{%- endunless %}
{%- endif %}
{%- endif %}
{%- endfor %}
{%- comment %} Plain `for` over the collection: nil-safe for the upstream
  `_config_theme-dev.yml` CI build (`script/cibuild`), where `site.vi_posts`
  is undefined. {% endcomment %}
{%- for post in site.vi_posts %}
{%- if post.url %}
- {{ site.url }}{{ post.url }}: {% if post.description %}{{ post.description | strip_newlines | strip }}{% elsif post.excerpt %}{{ post.excerpt | strip_html | strip_newlines | truncate: 155, "..." | strip }}{% else %}{{ post.title }}{% endif %}
{%- endif %}
{%- endfor %}
